infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Anomaly uses your location to find theatres, places and weather near you.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Anomaly uses the microphone for hold-to-talk voice input.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Anomaly transcribes your voice on device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Anomaly attaches photos you choose to your messages.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Anomaly attaches photos you take to your messages.
